cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Alabama House District 103 (Mobile) since 2014. Former Mobile Register reporter and owner of B-Inspired Marketing and Consulting. Worked for the city of Mobile and as Mobile County public affairs director. Ran for Mobile mayor in 2025 and lost the runoff.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Barbara Drummond was born, where she was raised, or when she moved to Alabama. We found no documented stance from her on data centers or development. We found no documented actions or statements from her on homestead taxes, land ownership, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The list of bills she sponsored did not load in the page we read. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for her in 2026. Her only recorded campaign themes are from 2014, when she cited crime, jobs, education, workforce development and constitutional reform.

qual.background: Alabama House member since 2014 (12 years). Earlier worked as a newspaper reporter, owned a marketing and consulting firm, was executive director of administrative services and community affairs for the city of Mobile, and was public affairs director for Mobile County.
qual.why: More than a decade of prior legislative service, plus government administration and public affairs work and business ownership, fits the high band for writing law and the budget. Committee seats and nonprofit boards were not counted.
